data.name: ImportFile
data.value: Spreadsheet saved as CSV

data.name: ImportFileHelp
data.value: Comma, semicolon or tab separated, up to {0} rows and 1 MB. Split a larger inventory into several files; importing them one after another is safe.

data.name: ImportPreviewButton
data.value: Preview import

data.name: ImportHowItWorks
data.value: How the import works

data.name: ImportRuleCount
data.value: {0} is what is on hand after the import. Each location is set to the file's count: stock is added or removed to match, so a corrected file can be imported again without doubling anything.

data.name: ImportRuleItems
data.value: Items are matched by {0}. New items, categories, locations and lots are created, and values in the file update existing items. A file never changes how an existing item is tracked.

data.name: ImportRuleCatalogRows
data.value: A row with no {0} and no {1} only creates or updates the item; its stock is left alone.

data.name: ImportRuleLocations
data.value: {0} names a storage location, or a path such as Warehouse > Shelf A. Fill in {1} or {2} to put the stock in that station's or unit's storage; {0} then names a compartment inside it. A blank {0} uses the default location.

data.name: ImportRuleSerialized
data.value: Serialized equipment takes one row per asset, with its {0}. A serial number that is already recorded is left where it is.

data.name: ImportRuleLots
data.value: Items that expire are kept by lot: give the {0} and its {1} date. A lot is created the first time it appears.

data.name: ImportRuleCost
data.value: {0} is the price of one, in the item's measure, for that row. It values the stock the row adds, and becomes the item's default cost when the item has none yet.

data.name: ImportRuleControlled
data.value: Controlled substances are not imported: their stock needs a witnessed receipt.

data.name: ImportRuleAllOrNothing
data.value: Nothing is written until you apply, and the file is applied whole or not at all. If anything changes between the preview and applying, you see the new preview first.

data.name: ImportColumns
data.value: Columns

data.name: ImportColumnsHelp
data.value: Columns can be in any order and only {0} is required. Headers are matched ignoring case and spaces, and common names such as Qty, SKU or Serial are understood. Yes/no columns take Yes or No, {1} takes Bulk or Serialized, and dates are written 2027-03-31.

data.name: ImportColumnName
data.value: Column

data.name: ImportColumnMeaning
data.value: What it holds

data.name: ImportColumnItem
data.value: The item's name. Items are matched by name; a new name creates the item. Required.

data.name: ImportColumnCode
data.value: Your own item code or part number, e.g. MED-0042.

data.name: ImportColumnBarcode
data.value: The barcode printed on the item. It must not belong to another item.

data.name: ImportColumnCategory
data.value: The category, e.g. Medical, or a path such as Medical > Airway. Missing categories are created.

data.name: ImportColumnDescription
data.value: A longer description of the item.

data.name: ImportColumnUnitOfMeasure
data.value: How the item is counted: each, box, pair, ml. A new item without one is counted in "unit".

data.name: ImportColumnTracking
data.value: Bulk (counted by quantity) or Serialized (one asset per serial number). A new item with serial numbers is Serialized.

data.name: ImportColumnRequiresLot
data.value: Yes when the item's stock is kept by lot or batch.

data.name: ImportColumnRequiresExpiration
data.value: Yes when the item expires. Bulk items that expire are kept by lot.

data.name: ImportColumnUnitCost
data.value: The price of one, in the item's measure, for that row's stock, e.g. 12.50.

data.name: ImportColumnCurrency
data.value: Three-letter currency code for the item's costs, e.g. USD or EUR.

data.name: ImportColumnMinLevel
data.value: The department-wide minimum before the item counts as low.

data.name: ImportColumnMaxLevel
data.value: The most the department wants on hand.

data.name: ImportColumnReorderPoint
data.value: The department-wide quantity that triggers a reorder.

data.name: ImportColumnReorderQuantity
data.value: How many to order when reordering.

data.name: ImportColumnLocation
data.value: Where the stock is: a location name, or a path such as Warehouse > Shelf A. Missing locations are created.

data.name: ImportColumnStation
data.value: A station name: the stock is in that station's storage.

data.name: ImportColumnUnit
data.value: A unit name: the stock is in that unit's storage.

data.name: ImportColumnQuantity
data.value: How many are on hand at the location after the import. Blank leaves the stock alone.

data.name: ImportColumnParLevel
data.value: The minimum to keep at this row's location.

data.name: ImportColumnLot
data.value: The lot or batch number. Missing lots are created.

data.name: ImportColumnExpires
data.value: The lot's or asset's expiry date, e.g. 2027-03-31.

data.name: ImportColumnSerialNumber
data.value: One serialized asset per row. Serial numbers already recorded are left as they are.

data.name: ImportColumnAssetTag
data.value: The asset's tag number.

data.name: ImportColumnNote
data.value: A note recorded with the stock movement this row posts.

data.name: ErrorOperationUnavailable

data.name: ErrorInsufficientStock

data.name: ErrorInvalidIdentifier

data.name: ErrorCostReconciliationRequired

data.name: ErrorImportRowUnreadable

data.name: ErrorImportValueTooLong

data.name: ErrorImportInvalidNumber

data.name: ErrorImportInvalidDate

data.name: ErrorImportItemRequired

data.name: ErrorImportItemConflict

data.name: ErrorImportControlledSubstance

data.name: ErrorImportItemTrackingMismatch

data.name: ErrorImportStationOrUnit

data.name: ErrorImportLocationAmbiguous
data.value: More than one location has this name; give its path, station or unit.

data.name: ErrorImportLocationRequired
data.value: Give a location; the department has no default location.

data.name: ErrorImportSerialRequired
data.value: This item is serialized; give one serial number per row.

data.name: ErrorImportSerialOnBulkItem
data.value: This item is counted in bulk and has no serial numbers.

data.name: ErrorImportDuplicateLine
data.value: Another row already counts this item at this location and lot.

data.name: ErrorImportLotExpiryMismatch
data.value: This lot is recorded with a different expiry date.

data.name: ErrorInvalidText
data.value: This value is missing, too long or not allowed.

data.name: ErrorInvalidItem
data.value: This item value is not valid.

data.name: ErrorInvalidCost
data.value: Costs must be zero or more, with at most six decimals.

data.name: ErrorInvalidCurrency
data.value: Write a three-letter currency code, such as USD.

data.name: ErrorInvalidQuantity
data.value: Quantities must be zero or more, with at most six decimals.

data.name: ErrorInvalidParLevel
data.value: Par levels must be zero or more, with at most six decimals.

data.name: ErrorDuplicateItem
data.value: Another item already has this barcode.

data.name: ErrorDuplicateSerial
data.value: This serial number appears more than once for the item.

data.name: ErrorLotRequired
data.value: This item is kept by lot; give a lot number.

data.name: ErrorExpiryRequired
data.value: This item expires; give an expiry date.

data.name: ErrorExpiryRequiresLotTracking
data.value: A bulk item that expires must be kept by lot.

data.name: ErrorLotMismatch
data.value: This lot cannot take stock for this item.

data.name: ErrorLotCostMismatch
data.value: This lot already has a different cost.

data.name: ErrorItemUnavailable
data.value: This item is inactive; activate it before changing its stock.

data.name: ErrorItemCurrencyLocked
data.value: The item's currency cannot change once it has stock movements.

data.name: ErrorSerializedQuantity
data.value: A serialized asset is one per row; leave the quantity blank or 1.

data.name: ErrorInvalidAsset
data.value: This asset value is not valid.

data.name: ErrorLocationUnavailable
data.value: You cannot put stock at this location.

data.name: ErrorInvalidLocationHierarchy
data.value: This location path is not valid.

data.name: ErrorInvalidCategoryHierarchy
data.value: This category path is not valid.

data.name: ErrorHolderRequired
data.value: This location's station or unit is not valid.

data.name: ErrorKitMustBeSerialized
data.value: A kit must be serialized.

data.name: ErrorProtectedDataRequired
data.value: Unlock protected data to continue.

data.name: ErrorImportUnitOfMeasureDefaulted
data.value: No measure was given, so the new item gets the default one. Change it on the item if needed.

data.name: ErrorImportLocationIgnored
data.value: The location is ignored: this row has no quantity, serial number or par level.

data.name: ErrorImportAssetElsewhere
data.value: This serial number is recorded at another location; it is not moved.

data.name: ErrorImportAssetRetired
data.value: This serial number is recorded as lost, used up or retired; it is not changed.
